description: Complete an endpoint credit top-up after you have obtained a valid X-Payment payload. Accepts either a dashboard PAT with mcp:endpoints:write or mcp:* or a legacy endpoint API key.

accessToken.description: Your dashboard MCP personal access token (sgl_pat_*). Can be omitted when the connection sends Authorization: Bearer sgl_pat_*

paymentPayload.description: Raw X-Payment payload returned by the paying client, as JSON or base64 string

slug.description: Slug of the endpoint to top up

name: topup_endpoint_with_payment
